title: Fallout 3 — MQDadRef ACHR Changed Extra / Script-Instance Baseline Decoder v3.2e
question: Can the nonspecific MQDadRef ChangeType-1 payload observed in unrelated real Fallout 3 saves be decomposed far enough to distinguish script-instance and ordinary actor runtime fields from a future Vault112-localized James transition?

establishes: ChangedMobileObject begins with pipe-terminated Process Level
actor Changed Extra branch is selected by mask including bit31
Changed Extra is an array of Extra Type plus type-specific union payload
the 0x0D-mapped union grammar in this context is Script ID plus Script Event List
MobileObject fields follow wbChangedREFR before process-state payload
typed SaveData values use pipe 0x7C delimiters
VSVal low two bits encode width and decoded value is raw >> 2
ExtraDataList begins VSVal count then type byte then type-specific payload
actor payload order independently places Process Level before REFR/ExtraData
type 0x0D decoder grammar is RefID plus script-local/event state

source_label_disagreement.policy: DO_NOT_CANONICALIZE_FROM_LABEL_ALONE; USE PRIMARY_ESM TARGET RESOLUTION AND FIELD GRAMMAR
source_label_disagreement.resolution_for_mqdadref: The embedded RefID resolves in all three controls to 0001F40A, which F3DAD primary ESM evidence identifies as MQDadScript. Therefore the record is admitted as MQDadScript script-instance/local runtime state for this target, while the global semantic naming of ExtraType 0x0D remains source-disputed.

primary_esm_identity_bridge.source: F3DAD primary Fallout3.esm lineage recorded in v2.4.1

decoded_real_prefix.save_refid_lesson: Different three-byte save-local RefID values can resolve to the same authored FormID because type-0 RefIDs index each save's FormID array. Raw SaveRefID equality or inequality is not cross-save identity evidence.

mobile_object_baseline.interpretation: The first admitted field-level variation in these unrelated Vault 101 controls is ordinary MobileObject runtime variability. It explains part of the raw MQDadRef payload-hash divergence without invoking Vault112, Tranquility Lane, memory, or serialization.

falsified_shortcuts.reason: Type-aware decoding localizes at least one difference to ordinary MobileObject Unk074 while Extra 0x0D structure is stable.

falsified_shortcuts.reason: 001A3F, 001125 and 001A1E all resolve to authored FormID 0001F40A.

falsified_shortcuts.reason: The decoded real Extra entry resolves to MQDadScript and contains zero script/local vars and no event block in all three controls.

runtime_admission_upgrade.old_rule: presence plus payload/header differential above external baseline
runtime_admission_upgrade.new_rule: resolve save-local RefIDs first, then compare semantically decoded fields within a controlled same-lineage T1/T2/T3 series; classify script-instance, MobileObject, process, actor and quest layers separately before any event attribution
mandatory_controls: same plugin environment or explicit compatibility proof
no-op save pair near each boundary
resolved FormID identity rather than raw SaveRefID bytes
field-level classification for each claimed differential
temporal localization to the T1/T2/T3 transition
separate MQ04 quest-state and MQDadRef actor-state tracks

first_break_model.meaning: Without user boundary saves, format research can still reduce false-positive space by decoding the remaining ordinary actor/process baseline. It cannot substitute that work for the missing controlled James lineage.

implementation.ci_policy: Workflow checks exact event head, runs deterministic adversarial tests, then executes the decoder against the three pinned external real saves and emits a machine-readable receipt. Run IDs are intentionally external receipts rather than self-referential constants embedded in this gate.

allowed: MQDadRef's source-bound ACHR prefix is reproducibly decodable on three external real Fallout 3 saves.
The sole decoded Changed Extra entry in those controls resolves to MQDadScript and contains no saved script variables or event block.
Raw MQDadRef payload hashes and save-local RefIDs are too nonspecific for SAVE JAMES inference.
At least one raw payload difference is localized to ordinary MobileObject runtime state.
not_allowed: The external fixtures are Vault112 or Tranquility Lane lineage saves.
MQDadScript locals are James autobiographical memory.
A future script-local change proves Braun serialization.
Engine actor persistence is an in-world neural memory carrier.
SAVE JAMES is a vanilla executable rescue path.
